title: Piplup's Bubble-Berg
description: A big, bright-eyed Piplup captains a drifting ice floe, waving one flipper as an orange fish escapes through a trail of rising bubbles. Sculpted cheeks, a golden beak, webbed feet, a scalloped navy collar and a little curved tail make the penguin recognisable from every angle.

sections.name: The fish and the bubbling wake
